_note: Respellings applied ONLY to the text the voice reads (render.py), never to our quest text or the ASR check. Whole words, case kept. '*shire' place names depend on the voice's accent (voice_cast.json 'accent'): neutral voices read '-shyre' ('Goldshire' as written came out 'Goldsheer', 'Gold shire' as two words; 'Goldshyre' won the by-ear test), British-accented voices '-sher' (the producer, 2026-10-11). Respellings are written as one word, no hyphens (2026-10-14, the producer): the voice treats a hyphen as a break, and 63 of the 185 hyphenated names in passed lines came apart ('Zal. Ah, Zane', 'Kara. Nos'); 'Zalahzane' reads whole.

_dialect._note: (2026-10-16, the producer) an accent's spoken tics written as the voice should say them, in the voice's input only: the clone read 'the' as 'the' and lost Vol'jin's accent. Blizzard's own troll text spells it so (Zul'Farrak: 'De only trolls left in de Echo Isles'). 'ing' -> 'in'' for the dropped g. Dwarves tried 2026-10-16 (ye, yer, o', an', fer, me, -in'): no real gain and the blanket rule made some lines worse -- removed. 'their' -> 'deir' (2026-10-16, by ear: better than 'dey').

_auto_audit: 2026-10-30, the producer's respelling check: the wiki pages often give the pronunciation of ANOTHER name in the same article, so 17 words were swapped for other names (Deathwing read "Neltharion", Succubi "Sayaad", Highborne "Quel'dorei", Shu'halo "Tauren", Talador "Terokkar"...); and two targets taken from an accented recording (Mok'Nathal from Drek'Thar, Garadar from Saurfang). Removed, read as written: Succubi, Genedar, Lightmother, Deathwing, Shu'halo, Highborne, Lokra, Talador, Flamestrike, Calen, Vaelan, Kalec, Nari, Arathor, Rakshar, Dawgar, Telemancy, Mok'Nathal, Garadar. Nagas kept its s. Also corrected today: Theramore (Vol'jin's troll "Deramaw", removed), Alexstrasza ("Atekstrahza", from a misheard Malygos line), Korialstrasz ("Krasas", the wiki's Krasus).

_heard_wrong._note: name -> regexes on the speech check's transcript (case-sensitive) that mean the name was read wrong: the take is a retake (fault 'mispronounced'). Only lines whose text has the name. (2026-10-31) 'Defius' too: the producer heard 142's first 'Defias' as 'Defy U.S.' where Whisper wrote 'Defius' for both readings, so a 'Defius' is no proof either way -- it is a retake. Passes: 'Defias', 'Defy us/Us'. (2026-11-02) 'Draenei' (respelled Draneye, the producer's 'Dran-eye'): 'Drani', 'drainy', 'Drainer' are the second syllable lost; 'Drain eye' is right.

_heard_right._note: word -> regexes of the speech check's transcript that are the word said right, spelled the recognizer's way; applied only to lines whose text has the word (render.heard_right). (2026-11-02) 22 tauren clips on review heard as 'Torrin', 'Taran', 'Torren', 'Taren'; 624 longer tauren clips passed the same voices. 12114's 'Thankyeh' heard 'Thank you'.
